title: Away In A Manger
lyrics: A[F]way in a [Gm/F]manger, no [Bb]crib for a [F]bed
The [C7]little Lord Jesus lay [Bb/F]down his sweet [F]head
The [F]stars in the [Gm/F]sky looked [Bb]down where he [F]lay
I [F]love Thee, Lord [Gm/F]Jesus, look [Bb]down from the [F]sky;
B[F]e near me, Lord [Gm/F]Jesus, I [Bb]ask Thee to [F]stay,
Close [C7]by me forever, and [Bb/F]love me, I [F]pray.
And [C7]fit us for [F]Heaven to [Gm/Bb]live with Thee [F]there.
artist: Murray, James Ramsey (1841-1905), MacFarland, John T. (1851-1913)
